_comment: The Pokémon Champions ranked ladder, as the league understands it.
Tiers run bottom to top. Within a tier, ranks count DOWN from `ranks` to 1 — you start at
Poké Ball 4 and climb to Poké Ball 1, then promote to Great Ball 4. Each rank has a progress
gauge; wins fill it, losses drain it.
Players report their own standing, so these numbers only drive ordering, the progress helper
and promotion bonuses — the app never simulates the ladder, it records what you tell it.
If the game's numbers differ from these, edit this file; nothing in the code hard-codes a
tier name or a gauge size.
_progressComment: Each tier needs a different number of gauge steps to clear a rank: Poké Ball 3, Great Ball 4, Ultra Ball 5. Set per tier below.
_promotionComment: Paid once, the first time a team reaches each rank or tier. Climbing is the point of the league, so it pays properly.
